test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A class of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 70, and that of the rest is 62. What is the average score of the class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Ratio** of **students** = 12 : 18 = 2 : 3

Difference between **averages** = 70 − 62 = 8

Apply **Net Deviation** (taking 62 as base): (2 × 8) ÷ (2 + 3) = 16 ÷ 5 = 3.2

**Class Average** = 62 + 3.2 = 65.2

**∴ The correct answer is 65.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total students (n) = 30

Group 1: **Students** (n₁) = 12, **Average** (a₁) = 70

Group 2: **Students** (n₂) = 30 − 12 = 18, **Average** (a₂) = 62

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ec92059a03455c5121f7596a05b6b6d039298ddd3a02e9df403abba8a24885c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Total score** of 12 students = 12 × 70 = 840

⇒ **Total score** of 18 students = 18 × 62 = 1116

⇒ **Sum** of all scores = 840 + 1116 = 1956

⇒ **Average score** of the class = 1956 ÷ 30

⇒ Average score = 65.2

**∴ The correct answer is 65.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When a group is divided into subgroups with different averages, the combined average is the sum of (number × average) of each subgroup divided by the total count.

Net Deviation Method

To simplify calculations, assume a **base average** (usually the smaller value). The actual average = Base + (Net Deviation ÷ Total observations).

Arithmetic Mean

The most basic average type, calculated as Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations. Formula: μ = (Σxᵢ) ÷ n.</p
